import re
import sys

set_pattern = re.compile(r"([a-h]|TMP)\s*<-\s*(\d+)\s*;")
add_pattern = re.compile(
    r"([a-h]|TMP)\s*<-\s*\(\s*([a-h]|TMP)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100\s*;"
)

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.strip()

    match = set_pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        name, number = match.groups()
        values[name] = int(number)
        continue

    match = add_pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        destination, source, number = match.groups()
        values[destination] = (values[source] + int(number)) % 100

names = [*str("abcdefgh"), "TMP"]
print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
